headline: Executive order addresses the President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition and brings back the Presidential Fitness Test.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with the President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition, a federal advisory group on physical activity and healthy eating. It also reestablishes the Presidential Fitness Test, a physical fitness test that was once widely given to students in schools. No summary was provided, so details such as how the test will be run or what the council will do are not available here.

who_it_affects.how: Students may again be given the Presidential Fitness Test, though the title does not say how or where it will be used.
Schools may be involved in giving the reestablished fitness test, but the specific requirements are not stated in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 31, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the available information.
